column1: n-TimingAdvanceOffset2The N_TA-Offset2 to be applied for PDCCH order CFRA towards the active additionalPCI as specified in TS 38.133 [14] clause 7.1.1 and for all uplink transmissions on this serving cell associated to tag2 as specified in TS 38.213 [13] clause 4.2. This field is always present if SSB-MTC-AdditionalPCI is configured. It is absent otherwise. If absent, the N_TA-Offset is applied for all uplink transmissions on this serving cell associated to tag2.

tag2-flagIf this field is set to true, the tag2-Id is associated to value 0 and tag-Id is associated to value 1 of field TI bit in RAR, fallbackRAR and in the absolute TAC MAC CE, see TS 38.321 [3]. Otherwise, the tag2-Id is associated to value 1 and tag-Id is associated to value 0 of field TI bit in RAR, fallbackRAR and in the absolute TAC MAC CE, see TS 38.321 [3].
tag2-IdTiming Advance Group ID, as specified in TS 38.321 [3], which this cell or set of TCI-States of this cell are associated with.
